description: Audited source-family partition of the 205-benchmark dataset. Selection uses source structure and workload diversity, never measured winners or model scores.

policy.assignment: Exact benchmark IDs; all variants in each family remain in the same partition.
policy.source_hash: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 source string stored in benchmarks.source.
policy.eligibility: Freeze this split before fitting. Compiler failures, multiple reports, unsupported analytics or missing candidate costs produce exclusions; they never trigger repartitioning.
policy.tuning_visibility: Only calibration reads tuning benchmarks; evaluate and evaluate-weights read validation benchmarks.
policy.audit: All 205 embedded selected_kernel bodies were inspected. Tuning has 30 single-loop kernels and one nested kernel (pathfinder-traverse); tqli-l72 has a data-dependent break. Source structure does not guarantee compiler eligibility.
policy.similarity_check: No tuning/validation kernel pair reached 0.90 SequenceMatcher similarity after identifier/number token normalization (autojunk=False). This is a source-duplication check, not a guarantee of semantic independence.
